description: React component for displaying a searchable, paginated list of channels with sync results, used in admin console access control modals.

methods.name: SearchableSyncJobChannelList
methods.description: React functional component rendering a searchable, paginated list of channels with sync results, including search input, navigation, and row click handling.

methods.name: createChannelRow
methods.description: Creates a JSX element representing a single channel row with sync info and click handler.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the previous page of channels.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles search input change, updates state, and triggers search.

methods.name: handleClear
methods.description: Clears the search input and resets search results.

methods.name: getEmptyStateMessage
methods.description: Returns a message component when no search results are found.
